_doc.HUB_PORT: TCP port of the laptop hub (WebSocket /hub plus static web/ and shared/).
_doc.TLS_CERT: Path to a TLS certificate; with TLS_KEY set the hub serves HTTPS/WSS (the phone needs it for its camera). Empty = plain HTTP.
_doc.TLS_KEY: Path to the TLS private key matching TLS_CERT. Empty = plain HTTP.
_doc.RADIO_GROUP: Existing gamepad/Cutebot radio group (0-255); optional legacy bridge must match. Laptop/phone video does not use radio.
_doc.DRIVE_HZ: How often the gamepad sends a drive packet, per second.
_doc.FAILSAFE_MS: Cutebot stops its motors if no drive packet arrives for this many milliseconds.
_doc.SAFETY_STOP_CM: Ultrasonic distance (cm) below which forward motion is blocked.
_doc.RECOIL_MS: Default length of the recoil manoeuvre in milliseconds.
_doc.VISION_HZ: Rate at which the eye page sends frames and the vision service publishes vision.state, per second.
_doc.VISION_HOST: Host of the vision service's HTTP server (snapshot.jpg). It runs on the laptop.
_doc.VISION_HTTP_PORT: Port of the vision service's HTTP server (snapshot.jpg).
_doc.FRAME_WIDTH: Width in pixels of the frames the eye page sends to the vision service (camera.frame).
_doc.CAMERA_HFOV_DEG: Horizontal field of view of the phone camera on the robot, in degrees.
_doc.VIEW_GRACE_S: Seconds an object may be missing from the robot's view before it counts as out of view.
_doc.OBJECT_FORGET_S: Seconds an object may stay out of view before it is forgotten (object_removed).
_doc.CLUSTER_GAP: Max gap (view units) between objects in view that form one cluster/place.
_doc.DANGER_SIZE: Size (fraction of the view, larger of width and height) at which a threat ahead is close enough for danger_enter.
_doc.FRIENDLY_SIZE: Size (fraction of the view) at which a friendly object ahead is close enough for friendly_enter.
_doc.NEAR_CM: Ultrasonic distance (cm) at which the object straight ahead counts as close, whatever its size in the view.
_doc.FACING_HALF_ANGLE_DEG: Half-angle (degrees) either side of straight ahead within which an object counts as faced.
_doc.FACING_MIN_SIZE: Smallest size (fraction of the view) an object needs to count as faced; smaller ones are far away.
_doc.AUDIO_DEVICE: Input device name or index for the microphone; empty = system default.
_doc.AUDIO_RATE: Audio capture sample rate in Hz.
_doc.CLIP_SECONDS: Length of the audio clip sent to Gemini, in seconds.
_doc.GEMINI_INTERVAL_S: Minimum seconds between Gemini world-compose calls.
_doc.GEMINI_TIMEOUT_S: Seconds before a Gemini call is abandoned (the last world is kept).
_doc.GEMINI_MODEL: Gemini model name used by the world composer.
_doc.WORLD_CHANGE_THRESHOLD: Music-signature distance (0-1) above which a new world is adopted.
_doc.RETURN_MATCH_THRESHOLD: Music-signature distance (0-1) below which a known world is recognised as returning.
_doc.NARRATION_MAX_CHARS: Longest narration line spoken, in characters.
_doc.TRANSITION_MS: Duration of the world-change transition in milliseconds.
_doc.LIGHT_MAX_HZ: Max rate of light commands sent to the robot, per second.
